name: Lance (Image+Video)
description: ByteDance Lance: a 3B unified model for image + video generation, editing and understanding. OAIY serves it through lance_server.py, which exposes a JSON API (POST /generate) for oaiy-web AND mounts Lance's own Gradio UI at /ui on the same port. One-click install sets up a Python 3.11 venv (CUDA PyTorch 2.8 + an SDPA flash_attn shim), fetches the Lance repo + requirements, and downloads the weights into the models folder. LANCE_GPUS lists the GPUs to run on (one full model copy per GPU = that many concurrent jobs); a single large 480p clip needs ~40GB peak, so keep resolution/frames modest per card, or lower LANCE_GPUS to your GPU count. To instead fit ONE big clip across all GPUs, set OAIY_LANCE_SHARD=1 (experimental device_map sharding) or OAIY_LANCE_OFFLOAD=1 (CPU offload, slow but fits anything).
